newsitem.title: USA: US sends states $376 mln in royalties through Sept.
newsitem.headline: US sends states $376 mln in royalties through Sept.

text.p: The U.S. Minerals Management Service distributed $376 million to 37 states in the first nine months of 1996, representing the states' share of royalty revenues collected for oil, gas and minerals from federal lands in their borders or waters off their shores.
Wyoming received the most at $140 million, followed by New Mexico with $96 million, Colorado with $27 million, and California with $23 million.

For production on land, all states except Alaska receive 50 percent of the revenues collected by MMS. Alaska receives 90 percent. For oil and gas produced offshore, states receive 27 percent of the royalties.
